title: HNSW Production Patterns: Steal-List for Synapse ANN
mission: Match usearch (4852-8500 QPS @ recall ≥0.92) on M4 Max
key_insights: Bitset-backed visited set, not HashSet (cache locality)
Per-layer pruning reduces candidate heap size 3-4×
Concurrent build with RwLock on layers wins over sequential

hot_loop_idiom.description: Inner search loop: greedy walk + candidate heap
hot_loop_idiom.usearch_pattern: while !candidates.is_empty() { c = candidates.pop(); if c.dist < eps { break; } for neigh in layer[c.id] { d = distance(query, vectors[neigh]); if d < eps { candidates.push(neigh, d); } } }
hot_loop_idiom.key_detail: Pop best (min-heap), check distance once per candidate, short-circuit on epsilon match

distance_kernel.usearch_approach: Fused distance + prefetch; inline for hot path
distance_kernel.code_snippet: inline float distance_at(const float* a, const float* b, size_t dim) { float sum=0; for(size_t i=0; i<dim; i+=4) { __m256 av=_mm256_loadu_ps(&a[i]); __m256 bv=_mm256_loadu_ps(&b[i]); __m256 diff=_mm256_sub_ps(av,bv); sum += horizontal_sum(_mm256_mul_ps(diff,diff)); } return sqrt(sum); }
distance_kernel.m4_specific: Use NEON vsubq_f32, vmulq_f32, vaddq_f32; arm64e can fuse with prefetch
distance_kernel.lance_variant: Lazy evaluation: defer sqrt until tie-break

memory_layout.description: Graph structure: layers, links, entry points

qdrant_layout.GraphLayers: { hnsw_m: u32, links: Vec<Vec<u32>>, entry_points: BTreeSet<(Layer, u32)> }

lance_layout.HnswBuilder: { nodes: Arc<Vec<RwLock<GraphBuilderNode>>>, level_count: Vec<usize>, visited_pool: VisitedPool }
lance_layout.key_win: RwLock per-node for lock-free reads during concurrent build

memory_layout.cache_alignment: Pad nodes to 64-byte cache line; keep link vectors in separate allocation

when_to_prefetch: Next neighbor IDs before distance lookup
Query vector bytes at loop start
prefetch_strategy.effect: 3-4× speedup on large graphs (>100M vectors), minimal on <1M

visit_set_type.qdrant_impl: VisitedPool: reusable bitsets per thread, generation-based reset (no zeroing)
visit_set_type.code_snippet: struct VisitedListHandle { bitset: Vec<u8>, generation: u32 } ... visited_pool.acquire(); mark_visited(id); is_visited(id) -> bitset[id/8] & (1 << id%8)

candidate_heap.optimization: Pre-allocate to max_neighbors * num_layers; reuse across searches
candidate_heap.pruning: Per-layer: discard candidates with dist > layer_threshold + delta

simd_intrinsics.description: ARM NEON / x86 SIMD for distance
arm_neon: vaddq_f32(sum, prod): horizontal add into scalar
simd_intrinsics.m4_max_win: NEON is single-cycle on Apple P-core; Prefetch + NEON = 0.8ns per float-pair

quant_cascade.level_3: i8 coarse if building index (Lance does this)
quant_cascade.effect: 10-30% index build speedup; <1% recall loss if tuned

concurrent_build.lance_pattern: For each new node: (1) insert into random layer 0, (2) RwLock read layers 1..L, (3) find neighbors per layer in parallel, (4) update links with CAS or buffered writes
concurrent_build.qdrant_pattern: Sequential node insert, but parallel link-pruning per layer
concurrent_build.key_win: RwLock > Mutex; read-only search doesn't block building

m4_specific_recommendations.distance_kernel: Inline + ARM NEON; unroll 4-wide loops; use __builtin_prefetch(ptr, 0, 3) for next vector
m4_specific_recommendations.visited_set: Bitset only; one generation counter per thread; no allocations in hot path
m4_specific_recommendations.graph_layout: Layers separate from links; links = Vec<Vec<u32>>, compressed (no gaps)
m4_specific_recommendations.build_parallelism: RwLock per-node; Rayon parallel_iter on layer levels, not candidates
m4_specific_recommendations.memory_pool: Pre-allocate candidate heap (size = m * avg_neighbors); reuse via Vec::clear()

estimated_speedup.full_m4_tuning: 8000-8500 QPS (all above + concurrent build + memory pool)

reference_code_snippets.search_inner_loop: while let Some((dist, id)) = candidates.pop() { if dist > eps_min { break; } prefetch(&neighbors[id]); for &nid in &neighbors[id] { let nd = distance_m128(&query_v, &data[nid]); if nd < candidates.peek_min_dist() { candidates.push(nid, nd); } } }
reference_code_snippets.prefetch_pattern: const PREFETCH_DIST: usize = 8; for i in 0..neighbors.len() { prefetch(&data[neighbors[i+PREFETCH_DIST % neighbors.len()]]); let d = distance(&query, &data[neighbors[i]]); }
reference_code_snippets.bitset_mark_visited: const GEN: u32 = visited_gen; visited_bits[id as usize >> 3] |= 1 << (id & 7); is_visited(id) -> (visited_bits[id >> 3] & (1 << (id & 7))) != 0 && gen_at[id] == GEN

next_steps: Port distance_kernel to Rust with inline + NEON intrinsics
Replace HashSet with bitset + generation counter in Synapse search()
Add prefetch macro wrapper (conditional: aarch64 vs x86)
Benchmark on M4 Max: prefetch alone = 1.3×, bitset = 1.2×, kernel = 1.8× → target 3-4× combined
